questions.question: High performer vs low performer management:
options: Stretch and visibility for high; clear expectations, coaching, and timelines for low
Punish high performers with all pages
questions.explanation: Classic manager LP interview; also GSRE C5 parallel.

questions.question: 24x7 rotation health requires:
options: Fair schedules, alert hygiene, and tracking load per engineer
questions.explanation: JD: day-to-day oversight of effective 24x7 rotation.

questions.question: Chronic noisy alerts — manager action:
options: Drive engineering to fix signal quality; measure pages reduced

questions.question: 1:1s should cover:
options: Growth, blockers, wellbeing, and technical coaching — not only status

questions.question: Escalation during critical issue — manager role:
options: Ensure IC/commander clarity, stakeholder updates, and remove blockers
questions.explanation: JD: escalation and critical issue management.

questions.question: Quality audit of ops means:
options: Sample changes/incidents for process adherence and learning

questions.question: Burnout signal in network ops teams:
options: Rising pages, declining change quality, attrition risk — act systemically

questions.question: Project management for the team includes:
options: Clear owners, milestones, risks, and reporting to leadership

questions.question: When two engineers conflict on design:
options: Facilitate data-driven decision; then disagree-and-commit as a team

questions.question: Training investment is justified when:
options: It raises team capability on critical platforms and reduces risk
It is only for travel perks

questions.question: On-call participation for managers:
options: Stay close enough to dive deep and support escalations — role-appropriate
questions.explanation: Preferred quals: manage on-call and escalation.

questions.question: Team goal setting should be:
options: Credible, measurable, aligned to customer/network outcomes
Individual only with no team goals
questions.explanation: JD: define and deliver goals; communicate objectives.

questions.question: After a painful incident, people care looks like:
options: Blameless learning + recovery time + systemic fixes
Immediate PIP for everyone on shift
questions.explanation: Combine Highest Standards with Best Employer.
